title: Accounts Receivable Rule: Reliance on the Deposit by Forwarding Address and Refund Method
content:
# Forwarding Share — Utility Services Program Move-Out Utility Payment

**Rule.** In working out the move-out utility payment of a Utility Services Program account, the deposit expected to reach utilities is relied on in a forwarding share set by the lease's Security Deposit Account:

| Security Deposit Account records | Forwarding share |
|---|---|
| a forwarding address, with direct deposit as refund method | 1.0 |
| a forwarding address, with paper check as refund method | 0.50 |
| no forwarding address | 0 (no reliance) |

The deposit relied on is the deposit expected to reach utilities multiplied by the forwarding share; the product is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end, and the deposit relied on never exceeds the final utility balance.

**Records read.** Whether a forwarding address is recorded on the Security Deposit Account, and the refund method recorded there.

*Cases (hypothetical deposit expected to reach utilities of $240.00, final utility balance $500.00):* the deposit expected to reach utilities taken at the forwarding share is $240.00 with direct deposit, $120.00 with paper check and $0.00 with no forwarding address.
